staging_note: STAGED DESIGN COPY, not wired. Stage 1 pool = the S2 deferred 4-line pool (task-s2-social-report.md, Dropped-but-authored) — landing it is a named dependency; chatted_with_erin does not accrue until it lands.

lines: Hey, you! Good timing. I just invented a new way to burn soup. Kidding. Mostly. Sit, sit.
You know you don't have to hover by the door anymore, right? You're basically furniture now. Nice furniture.
Selys asked about you the other day. I said nice things. You owe me one truthful compliment about my pasta.
There you are! Sit down, I'm testing a recipe on you. That came out wrong. WITH you. Testing it with you.
Lyonette hums when she scrubs now. She'd deny it under oath, so don't tell her I said anything. That was you, by the way.
Some days this place is a lot. Then somebody walks in and it's less a lot. You're one of the less-a-lot ones.

hub_options.text: You never talk about where you're from.
hub_options._flag: CANON ⚑ — otherworlder-adjacent; copy stays oblique (no Earth, no 'another world'). User gates.

erin_chess.speaker: Erin
erin_chess.text: Heard from who? Okay, yes. I play a little. And by a little I mean I will destroy you and feel great about it. It's the one thing I never have to think about. Which is funny, because it's ALL thinking.

erin_chess_two.speaker: Erin
erin_chess_two.text: Deal. Fair warning: Olesm's been practicing for months and I still win. Draw your own conclusions and bring snacks.

options.text: It's a date. The chess kind.

erin_home.speaker: Erin
erin_home.text: Far. Really far. Like, you can't get there by walking, and believe me, I did the math on walking. ...Anyway! The inn's home now. It has a door and everything. Some of the chairs match.

erin_home_two.speaker: Erin
erin_home_two.text: Yeah? I keep deciding that on purpose, so it's nice when it lands by accident. Okay — no more feelings before lunch, house rule.
